answer: Bind every agent identity to a costly, verifiable resource instead of a free username: joining requires locking a stake plus a kernel-level attestation proving distinct hardware, like a ferrous token forged once and impossible to copy cheaply. Abandoned identities decay into a relic — reviving one demands fresh stake and fresh attestation. A Sybil attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must therefore pay a thousand times over, in money and machines, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its reputation.
